MACH_BUILD_PYTHON_NATIVE_PACKAGE_SOURCE: system
    use-python: default
    locale-list:
        by-project:
            enterprise-thunderbird: comm/mail/locales/all-locales-enterprise
            default: comm/mail/locales/onchange-locales
    comm-locales-file:
        by-project:
            enterprise-thunderbird: comm/mail/locales/enterprise-l10n-changesets.json
            default: comm/mail/locales/l10n-changesets.json
    browser-locales-file:
        by-project:
            enterprise-thunderbird: browser/locales/enterprise-l10n-changesets.json
            default: browser/locales/l10n-changesets.json
    run:
        using: mozharness
        comm-checkout: true
        clone-with: hg
        actions:
            - clone-gecko-locales
            - clone-comm-locales
            - merge-repos
            - pack-merged
        script: comm/taskcluster/scripts/desktop_comm_l10n.py
        config-paths:
            - comm/testing/mozharness/configs
        config:
            by-project:
                enterprise-thunderbird:
                    - single_locale/linux64.py
                    - single_locale/tc_common.py
                    - single_locale/thunderbird_split_l10n.py
                    - single_locale/enterprise_thunderbird_split_l10n.py
                    - taskcluster_nightly.py
                default:
                    - single_locale/linux64.py
                    - single_locale/tc_common.py
